_doc: Trust registry: a paper is trusted (1) when an author, an organization or affiliation, or an author email domain matches an entry here, else 0 (dsys/reputation.py). Universities come from the QS World University Rankings top 1000 (scripts/build_reputation.py, run by the build-reputation workflow) plus hand-added research groups; labs and researchers are curated. The monthly run adds recurring strong groups and authors from state/reputation_log.json, recording the papers that justify each addition in 'added'.
